src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Compose from the message and inspected advertiser-relevant references. Identify the visual invariants first: focal scale, type/image relationships, reading order, material behavior, characteristic spacing and authentic identity treatment. Translate those relationships to this content; no full-page skeleton is binding.
note: Brand-look rule in the always-loaded guide, but framed for composing a new ad.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Establish one dominant element, a clear second read and intentional space. Components are reusable mechanics, not fixed proportions, mandatory cards or required layout patterns. Recompose for the actual words, imagery and aspect ratio.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Type-only is a valid finished direction when imagery is optional; requested new artwork still needs generation. CTA, eyebrow, benefit row and proof card are optional.
note: Fourth copy of "new artwork needs generation".

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Use native editable text for copy, native geometry for frames, simple paths, connectors and diagrams. Use real independently placeable images for logos and authentic product screenshots/photos. Never redraw, recolor or typeset a substitute logo.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: A recognizable authentic target favicon may be a deliberate account identity anchor; it cannot replace an explicitly required readable wordmark. Choose a supplied variant that fits its background. Missing variants are gaps; a white plate is not the absent reversed logo. Preserve the source logo's aspect and real clearspace guidance.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Inspect visible ink against the local background, including transparent padding and texture … Choose a contrasting authentic variant or repair the surrounding composition. A group of separate unchanged real logos and a native separator is valid.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Related headline, support and action should read as one message group … A group can be asymmetric and need no visible card or vertical stack. A headline and its explanation should not become separate islands.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Size supporting copy with the approved headline, actual font and inspected brand reference before allocating the image region. A kit's body role may describe website text, not a scaled ad. Establish both the first read and a comfortable second read … nominal font size alone cannot choose the right relationship.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: When a user supplies a corrected composition, inspect its current resolved typography and keep that relationship for this design's repairs and requested variants. The saved scene is evidence of that local choice, not a global brand preference.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: The diagnostic resolved_font_size * viewing_width / page_width explains how type scales; it is not a universal size target. If a caller explicitly selected a numeric review profile, satisfy it alongside visual hierarchy … With no selected profile, do not invent a numeric acceptance floor.
note: A review profile ("legible-feed-v1") is attached to every candidate turn via brief.md (H1), so the agent always has one.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Preserve an approved headline and change support only as far as needed for the second read … stop when the explanation is readable and subordinate.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: 1. Use brand tokens and the kit's families/weights. Choose headline width from phrase breaks and focal scale … Prefer content-hugging text height … No fixed width, line count, type ratio or margin fraction follows from this procedure.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: 2. After preflight, use inspect(view="geometry") for related text and container nodes … computed.text_lines gives each measured line box … Check the visible ink in the current render too.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: 3. Repair the cause of a disconnected group: excess fixed-height slack, a stale offset, a narrow support box, or unrelated padding … Adjust dependent positions after reflow … honor a pinned node's authoritative absolute_box.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: 4. If the direction includes a CTA, keep its native label and any button geometry in one coherent component … Avoid an independently floating label or detached action island. A creative without a CTA needs no reserved action row.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: For emphasis within a sentence, prefer a supported span in one native text node … [[phrase]] plus span(...) supports fill, weight, italic and decorations; not family, size or leading … A content edit clears old spans: restore the intended emphasis.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Quotes and metrics use independent native text with source-backed qualification and attribution. Their treatment follows the inspected examples, not a compulsory card. Use native connectors only when the relationship is real.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Page before spend: on a pageless document compile explicit page dimensions before logo or image operations … Creative nodes and artwork construction, including new imagery spend, follow validated direction. Reserve artwork as an empty leaf fr.
note: Fifth home of the page-before-spend rule.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: asset(action="place") accepts that frame or an existing image: it changes the leaf to an image in place, preserving its ID, parent/order and geometry. It cannot consume a frame with children.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Small mechanical example (compile a page with an fr reservation, generate_image with reference_asset_ids=[], view, place).
note: The one worked example uses reference_asset_ids=[] (no references), i.e. it teaches generating without the brand's references.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: For a known existing asset, skip generation and place its real ID; kit assets use use_brand_asset … Direct DSL image asset(<id>) is also valid … no dummy ID or blank image is needed before placement.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Don't generate a flattened complete ad. Text, CTA, logo and product pixels remain independent layers.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Logos use contain with clear space; product crops preserve the relevant UI or object. Don't destructively crop an asset just to rescue a preselected skeleton.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Image fit changes pixels inside the node, not the node's layout bounds … Do not progressively enlarge and offset a child beyond its parent to guess a crop … If the desired crop cannot preserve the meaningful UI, adapt the frame or choose a different source.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: For exact source-pixel extraction, use crop_image with integer bounds in original pixels … Inspect it before explicitly placing it.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: An inspected reference's soft material, blur, tonal variation or texture is part of its treatment. A flat brand-color rectangle does not preserve those properties. Reuse appropriate source artwork or generate the separately placeable treatment; use a flat field only when that is the intended and justified visual direction.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Author through compile_dsl_block or supported checked operations only. The DSL grammar/directives and artboard-frame reference are authoritative mechanics.
note: Does not mention apply_structured_edit, which the follow-up routine makes the default edit tool.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Reparenting changes parent-relative placement and paint order … use before, after or indexed parent … pinned absolute nodes use a separate page pass above managed content.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: Use measured geometry for repairs and keep unrelated existing content intact.
note: Keep-it rule #6 — in the guide pasted into every turn.

src: knowledge_docs/views/scene/knowledge/scene/components.md (pinned into the system prompt every turn)
text: After changes: preflight, render, view the actual composite and repair the specific failure. Components that compile still need visual judgment.
